acceptance.krippendorff_alpha: descriptive with confidence interval when estimable; never a sole gate
acceptance.tost_equivalence: prohibited unless a separate power analysis, equivalence margin, and coder-group design are frozen before judgments

adaptive_rule.agent_only_flag: advisory until reproduced deterministically or confirmed by a blinded human
adaptive_rule.confirmed_internal_defect: convert to a deterministic counterexample and existing construct-gate test; pause live execution
adaptive_rule.one_original_reliability_event: expand independent double review to the frozen 88-case sample
adaptive_rule.two_or_more_original_reliability_events: expand primary review to all 308 claim-bearing cases and secondary review to every mismatch
adaptive_rule.zero_original_reliability_events: stop human original review after the 44-case pilot

claims_permitted: human-reviewed clarity and outcome agreement for the audited fixed-suite sample
agent reproduced human consensus on the audited sample if every frozen acceptance rule passes
claims_prohibited: human-equivalent intelligence or universal annotator replacement
a population defect-rate bound from the coverage-optimized sample

external_validity.required_separate_study: provenance-bound probability sample of real target workflows with qualified end-user outcome assessment

objectives: human interpretability and content validity of an outcome-blind audited sample
agent reproduction of sealed human consensus on the audited sample
agent sensitivity to balanced blinded valid and invalid challenge packets
